gloss_en: The Aramaic (Zoharic) devotional formula לְאַדְבָּקָא מַחֲשַׁבְתָּא בְּעָלְמָא דְּאָתֵי — 'to attach/bind one's thought to the World to Come' — used in Likutey Moharan I:54 as the spiritual state underlying memory (zikaron) and effected 'in totality/generality' (בִּכְלָלִיּוּת) through sleep, when the soul ascends to the World to Come; not any literal physical clinging or other sense of דבק
